newsitem.title: JAPAN: Maruwa Ceramic to buy back shares for stock option.
newsitem.headline: Maruwa Ceramic to buy back shares for stock option.

text.p: Maruwa Ceramic Co Ltd said on Friday that it would buy back 50,000 of its shares, or 100 million yen worth, in order to introduce a stock option scheme.
Stock options give holders the right to buy shares at a set price within a certain period.
Japan changed the law this month to allow firms to buy back up to 10 percent of their own shares for use in stock option schemes for employees and executives.
Japanese business leaders have said that the system will help motivate employees to work hard.
Maruwa Ceramic produces ceramics for electronic parts.
